nodes.title: ElevenLabs Agents public teardown (account-free): 56 graded claims (44 observed, 9 inferred, 3 vendor-claimed) from the 804-page docs index (258 pages saved as Markdown), the public OpenAPI (322 paths, 141 convai), pricing pages, 32 changelog entries, the incident.io status feed, 6 npm SDKs and the PyPI SDK, DNS/RDAP of 19 hostnames, passive captures of elevenlabs.io/agents and the signed-out app, one 25 s public demo call, 157 job posts, Trustpilot, GitHub issues and HN. sha256 manifest of 3,809 raw files.

ElevenLabs is building a lead-level outbound campaign product that is not public yet. The signed-out dashboard bundle carries 23 unpublished /v1/convai/outbound-campaigns routes: campaigns submit/pause/resume/stop/progress/export, leads with suppressLead, an attention queue (resolve/retry), workspace config and pre-revoke-status. Conversation records already carry campaign_id, campaign_lead_id, cold_attempt and conversation_type (initial/retry/callback/redirect). The public product is still single-start batch calling with no calling window, retry policy or suppression. Of 568 convai routes in the bundle, 326 are absent from the public OpenAPI (also automations, task-agents, memories, templates).

ElevenLabs has an India data-residency environment, but only on Enterprise. The 2026-10-17 parity row "no India region found" is wrong. in.residency.elevenlabs.io is a separate workspace: storage is in India, "processing may nevertheless occur outside", Realtime v1 Max is not offered there and agents are not migrated. DNS shows SIP is regional: sip.rtc.elevenlabs.io is in GCP us-central1 and sip.rtc.in.residency.elevenlabs.io is in asia-south1 (Mumbai). The static-IP SIP /24 (199.88.252.0/24) is registered to Eleven Labs Inc. Inference: a self-serve Indian buyer on SIP has media anchored in Iowa, adding about one India-US round trip (~200-250 ms) per turn, and faces the TRAI rule that Indian SIP termination needs an Indian server.

Exotel has been a first-class ElevenAgents telephony provider since 2026-06-01, alongside Twilio and SIP. Exotel's Voicebot applet streams 8 kHz PCM over a WebSocket to ElevenLabs; outbound uses Exotel Calls/connect with the buyer's own keys; the Mumbai and Singapore clusters are supported. Friction: Exotel support must first enable the gated Voicebot applet and provision channels (1-2 business days), and transfer needs a chained Connect applet. This is the self-serve route to a domestic Indian CLI that Vapi lacks. The India page also claims Ozonetel and Plivo integrations and Indian agent customers (Meesho, Cars24, TVS Motor; vendor-claimed).

ElevenAgents leaves Indian calling compliance to the buyer. The 258 saved docs pages never mention TRAI, DLT, NCPR/DND, the 140/160 series or Indian calling hours; the only telemarketing-law page is TCPA. The public batch API has no calling-window, DNC, consent or suppression field. AI disclosure and recording consent are contractual duties of the buyer. Twilio regional routing offers only us1/ie1/au1.

ElevenAgents all-in list price for an Indian outbound minute at FX 95: INR 8.17-8.92 via Exotel or Plivo, INR 15.8-16.5 in burst, INR 12.5-15.0 via Twilio. The platform fee is $0.08 = INR 7.60 on every plan and is unchanged in USD since 2026-06-06. The rest is LLM pass-through (INR 0.19-0.72) and telephony (INR 0.38-0.60). The $0.08 fee is 3.9x the same ASR and TTS on ElevenLabs' own API list. Reconstructed platform COGS of INR 0.20-1.38/min implies an 82-97% gross margin (inference, not measured).
nodes.n: 4 price components (platform, burst, LLM pass-through range from g4 workload, telephony range) + 3 own-API list prices
nodes.method: computed from elevenlabs.io/pricing/agents and /pricing/api read 2026-10-20, g4 prices.csv/selfhost tables and l2 telephony rates (code/pricing.py); list prices, not an invoice

nodes.title: ElevenLabs velocity and reliability. From 2026-04-01 to 2026-10-12 there were 32 changelog entries (about weekly) with 296 headline items, 195 of them for ElevenAgents (median 6 per entry), plus weekly SDK releases (JS/Python 2.74 on 2026-10-20). The status feed (incident.io) shows 25 incidents from 2026-07-31 to 2026-10-13: 9 name Agents, SIP, Twilio, batch calling or conversation history, 4 are SIP/Twilio telephony and 5 are EU-residency.
nodes.method: elevenlabs.io/docs/changelog/llms.txt and each entry .md (items counted per section by code), status.elevenlabs.io/feed.rss parsed; fetched 2026-10-20

nodes.title:
ElevenLabs v2 signals.
- Memory across calls is undocumented but in the data model: memory entries with version and a conversation/manual source. The dashboard calls /agents/{id}/memories and /agents/{id}/user-memory/preview.
- Personalisation today is per call only: dynamic variables, overrides and user_id.
- The improvement loop is human-gated: Spotlight finds an issue, Architect proposes a branch with tests, a teammate merges, and experiments split traffic with manual promotion.
- "Proactive proposals" and scheduled automations are announced; the bundle already calls /convai/automations and /triage-tickets/{id}/architect-dispatches.

nodes.rationale: Public evidence shows ElevenLabs owns the speech stack (ASR, TTS, turn model, S2S), ships ~6 agent features a week, already solved domestic Indian telephony through Exotel, and is building leads/suppression/retries; its platform margin is 82-97% (inferred) so a price cut is cheap for it. Its public gaps for Indian outbound are regional processing for self-serve buyers, Indian compliance controls, Hinglish handling and India-specific failure reasons.
nodes.reverse_if: ElevenLabs makes outbound campaigns public with calling windows and suppression and offers India-region processing on self-serve plans; or the account phase measures handset p50 <= 1.5 s with >= 90% Hinglish language hold on the default configuration; or it prices Indian minutes at or below INR 4 all-in.

nodes.title: Within about one quarter, ElevenLabs could launch its hidden outbound-campaigns product (leads, retries, suppression) and cross-call memory, and cut its Indian price toward INR 4/min. A 82-97% platform margin (inferred) makes the cut affordable. That would close the usability and price gaps VP is targeting, leaving only India-resident latency, compliance and Hinglish quality.
nodes.mitigation: Re-run code/bundle_endpoints.py weekly against the signed-out app bundle and the public OpenAPI (radar watchlist), and diff the changelog. Build VP's Indian operator layer (DLT/140-160 declaration, NCPR scrub, consent ledger, IST windows, business-language outcomes) as the product, and keep India-resident processing on every plan.

nodes.title:
Do the pre-registered ElevenLabs account-phase predictions EL-P01 to EL-P12 hold?
- Web call within 10 min, but an Indian-handset call takes >= 30 min via Twilio and >= 1 business day via Exotel.
- The CSV keeps duplicates and the opt-out row and does not prefix +91.
- There is no calling window.
- LLM voicemail detection misses Indian operator announcements.
- Handset reply gap p50 is 2.0-3.2 s on a standard plan.
- There is no cross-call memory by default.
nodes.closes_when: An ElevenLabs trial (the existing free account from the Instinct report, plus an Exotel or Twilio number) runs EL-P01 to EL-P12. That needs timed screen recordings, the 50-row CSV outcome per row, a scheduling attempt, three Indian operator announcements, the l4b battery on our Plivo/Exotel number (>= 30 clean turns, stereo), the invoice lines, and a check whether outbound-campaigns or memory is visible in the workspace.

nodes.title: Reusable unreleased-feature detector. bundle_endpoints.py pulls the generated API-client routes out of a signed-out dashboard's JS, using string matching only (nothing is executed), and diffs them against the vendor's public OpenAPI. With capture.mjs, har_scripts.py and har_slim.py it turns one passive sign-in page load into a list of unpublished product surfaces.
nodes.value: Found ElevenLabs outbound-campaigns, memories, automations and task-agents (326 unpublished routes) before any announcement. It runs weekly as change-watch on any vendor whose dashboard ships a generated client (Fern, OpenAPI codegen).
nodes.effort: about 1 minute per vendor per run, with no account
